_comment: Single-target weak-SNR variant of the missed-detections stress test (C.2). IDENTICAL to scenario_missed_detections.json (same range 4 m, same velocity 0.5 m/s, so the target stays well within the ~9.5 m unambiguous range for the whole 80-frame run) EXCEPT the amplitude is lowered from 0.0006 to 0.0005. This pushes detector Pd low enough that the tracker can no longer bridge the misses: the marginal target repeatedly drops below the CFAR threshold, the track dies and respawns with new IDs, and track-level Pd collapses to ~0.3. Across seeds this is a robust in-range failure (12/12 seeds fail), predominantly TOTAL CONFUSION (the die/respawn churn adds ID switches on top of the break). The point is to isolate a failure driven purely by missed detections while the target remains physically observable — the clean CLEAN->failure contrast against scenario_missed_detections.json, with SNR (amplitude) as the only changed parameter.
